$comment: Codes name a false BELIEF, not a topic. Add codes here before using them in a chapter; a code not listed fails validation. Extracted initially from the original 72-question bank. Codes carry review checkpoints, not hopes: refusal_implies_guilt merges into nothing_to_hide unless it reaches three uses by the end of chapter 2; police_need_proof_to_say_it, innocence_makes_talking_safe, rights_cover_only_me and guessing_is_harmless are single-use retags from chapter 1 and get the same call at the end of JUVENILE. The chapter 1 second pass added police_must_be_truthful and others_talking_voids_my_silence as single-use codes; both get the end-of-JUVENILE call like the earlier retag codes. The demo chapter (demo.01) adds its own codes below; they are written for a standalone set with no chapter context and are not part of the JUVENILE review checkpoints. The courtroom district (courtroom.01 and courtroom.02) added 171 codes, starting at judge_handles_paperwork. Nearly all are single-use within that district by design, since every wrong answer names a different belief. They get a merge-or-keep review once a second district reuses them.

codes.silence_is_automatic: Going quiet counts as invoking the right to remain silent (Berghuis v. Thompkins says it does not).
codes.partial_answers_are_safe: Answering small questions but not big ones is a safe middle ground.
codes.my_side_helps: Explaining your side of the story clears things up.
codes.talking_earns_leniency: Cooperating and talking gets you a break.
codes.unclear_request_counts: An unsure request for a lawyer is enough (Davis v. United States says it may not be).
codes.no_money_no_lawyer: You only get a lawyer if you can pay for one.
codes.miranda_at_arrest: The Miranda warning is required the moment you are arrested.
codes.booking_needs_miranda: Routine booking questions count as interrogation.
codes.nothing_to_hide: Refusing a search implies you have something to hide. How a refusal looks in the moment, to the person in front of you.
codes.refusal_implies_guilt: Saying no can be used against you later as evidence of guilt. What a refusal can be used for afterward, not how it looks at the time.
codes.police_can_always_search: A request to search is really a command.
codes.partial_consent_is_safe: Agreeing to a limited look keeps the search limited.
codes.opening_it_yourself_is_different: Showing them yourself is not the same as consenting.
codes.everything_needs_a_warrant: Police always need a warrant; plain view does not exist.
codes.holding_phone_means_reading_it: Seizing a phone permits searching its contents (Riley v. California).
codes.roommate_can_consent_to_anything: Anyone living in the home can consent to searching your private space.
codes.nerves_are_suspicion: Being nervous is by itself a good enough reason to stop or search someone.
codes.police_can_hold_anyone: Police can detain anyone for any reason.
codes.must_always_give_name: You must always identify yourself on demand (Michigan differs).
codes.id_law_is_national: ID requirements are the same in every state.
codes.passenger_has_driver_duties: A passenger has the same obligations as the driver.
codes.frisk_opens_everything: A pat-down permits a full search.
codes.can_refuse_to_exit: You can decline an order to step out of the car (Mimms/Wilson).
codes.illegal_stop_means_resist: An unlawful stop can be physically resisted.
codes.violation_means_self_help: A rights violation can be stopped on the spot.
codes.being_right_helps_now: Arguing the law during the encounter works.
codes.must_open_the_door: A knock obligates you to open the door.
codes.talking_at_open_door_is_safe: Opening the door to talk is not consent to enter.
codes.stepping_outside_is_neutral: Stepping outside your home costs you nothing.
codes.school_matches_street: Schools need the same justification police need (they need less; New Jersey v. T.L.O.).
codes.sro_is_off_the_record: Talking to a school resource officer is casual and off the record.
codes.filming_needs_permission: You need permission to record police.
codes.must_be_on_own_property: You can only record from your own property.
codes.any_dispersal_order_is_lawful: Any order to stop or disperse is lawful.
codes.private_recording_is_always_ok: Keeping a recording private makes it legal.
codes.rumor_is_enough: A name passed along, with nothing behind it, is by itself a good enough reason to search you.
codes.group_suspicion_covers_everyone: Suspicion about a group lets staff search every person in it.
codes.search_has_no_limits: Once a search has started, whatever started it lets staff look anywhere, in anything.
codes.finding_something_makes_it_legal: Whatever turned up proves the search was allowed.
codes.school_owns_what_you_bring: Anything you carry onto school grounds is school property and can be searched at will.
codes.my_lock_makes_it_private: Your own lock, or a locker fee you paid, makes the locker yours.
codes.the_lot_is_off_campus: A car parked at school gets the same protection as a car parked on the street.
codes.passcode_must_be_given: When staff take your phone, you have to unlock it for them.
codes.deleting_it_ends_it: Deleting a photo or a message puts it out of reach.
codes.suspicionless_checks_need_a_reason: Dog sweeps, metal detectors, and team drug testing each need a reason aimed at you personally.
codes.saying_no_stops_it_at_school: Refusing consent stops a school search the way it can stop a police search.
codes.saying_nothing_is_agreeing: Letting a search happen without objecting counts as agreeing to it.
codes.school_findings_stay_at_school: What school staff find cannot reach police or a court case.
codes.bad_search_undoes_discipline: If the search was improper, the school punishment goes away too.
codes.police_need_proof_to_say_it: Police cannot claim to have a confession or evidence unless they really do.
codes.innocence_makes_talking_safe: If you did nothing wrong, talking cannot hurt you.
codes.rights_cover_only_me: The right to remain silent only covers questions about yourself.
codes.guessing_is_harmless: Giving your best guess is safe as long as you are trying to tell the truth.
codes.off_campus_ends_school_rules: Once you are off school grounds, school staff have no more say than any other adult.
codes.only_police_really_search: What school staff do is not really a search; only a police search counts.
codes.school_needs_no_reason: At school, staff can search whatever they want without needing a reason at all.
codes.police_must_be_truthful: Police are not allowed to lie to you while they question you.
codes.parent_decides_for_me: A parent can decide for you whether you talk to police.
codes.others_talking_voids_my_silence: Once somebody else tells the story, staying quiet no longer helps you.
codes.rights_start_at_charges: Your rights only start once you have actually been charged with something.
codes.a_violation_throws_it_out: If police break a rule, whatever comes after is automatically thrown out.
codes.rights_depend_on_a_signal: Your rights only apply once something official happens: a uniform, handcuffs, or being told.
codes.the_label_decides_the_rule: What an adult calls it, a look, a check, a quick chat, decides which rules apply.
codes.the_handbook_is_the_law: Whatever the student handbook says is what the school is allowed to do.
codes.one_track_replaces_the_other: School discipline and a court case cannot both run; one takes over from the other.
codes.a_yes_cannot_be_taken_back: Once you agree to a search you cannot stop it partway through.
codes.tips_are_traced_back: A confidential tip can be traced back to whoever sent it.
codes.a_tip_needs_your_name: A report does not count unless you put your name on it.
codes.reporting_gets_me_an_update: You will be told what happened after you report something.
codes.confidentiality_is_absolute: A confidential tip stays sealed no matter what, with no exceptions.
codes.must_be_sure_to_report: You should only report something once you are certain it is real.
codes.check_it_yourself_first: You should find out whether it is true before telling anyone.
codes.being_wrong_is_worse_than_silence: Reporting something that turns out to be nothing is worse than saying nothing.
codes.tip_line_is_for_emergencies: A tip line is the right way to reach someone when danger is happening right now.
codes.later_is_soon_enough: Telling an adult later works as well as telling somebody now.
codes.posting_counts_as_telling: Putting it online is a way of telling people who can help.
codes.reporting_is_snitching: Telling an adult about a safety concern is the same act as snitching.
codes.knowing_makes_me_part_of_it: If you knew and stayed quiet, speaking up now makes you part of it.
codes.if_nothing_shows_nothing_happened: If nothing visible changes at school, nothing was done about it.
codes.a_prank_tip_is_harmless: A fake tip is a joke with no consequences attached to it.
codes.a_thin_tip_is_useless: A report is not worth sending unless you can give the whole story.
codes.only_firsthand_counts: Only what you saw yourself is worth reporting.
codes.only_on_campus_counts: A school tip line only covers what happens on school property.
codes.only_school_hours_count: A school tip line only covers what happens during the school day.
codes.school_can_ban_any_message: A school can ban a message simply because it disagrees with it.
codes.disruption_means_upset: A disruption is anything that annoys an adult or draws a complaint.
codes.free_speech_covers_everything: The First Amendment means a school cannot act on anything you say.
codes.school_paper_is_my_paper: Work published under the school's name is your own speech.
codes.only_falsehood_can_be_cut: School-sponsored work can only be cut if it is untrue.
codes.always_a_student: You are a student everywhere, so school rules follow you everywhere.
codes.school_device_is_like_my_phone: A school-issued device is as private as your own phone.
codes.they_have_to_tell_me_first: Staff must warn you before they look at anything of yours.
codes.telling_is_always_right: Telling an adult about anything a classmate does is always the right call.
codes.the_tip_line_can_overrule_school: A state tip line can force a school to change what it decided.
codes.telling_once_is_enough: Telling one adult finishes your part of it.
codes.a_protest_excuses_the_absence: Missing class for a protest does not count as skipping.
codes.students_cannot_disagree: Disagreeing with a teacher out loud is never allowed.
codes.school_discipline_is_a_trial: School discipline works like a court case, with lawyers and a judge.
codes.no_process_is_owed: A school can remove you without telling you why or letting you answer.
codes.nothing_counts_until_its_written: A decision is not real until it is written down.
codes.any_length_is_the_same: The rules are the same whether a removal is one day or sixty.
codes.factors_are_optional: Considering the required factors is something a school may do, not must do.
codes.discipline_needs_proof: A school has to prove it the way a criminal court would.
codes.one_person_decides_it_all: Whoever removed you from the room decides how long you are out.
codes.discipline_is_a_criminal_record: A school suspension goes on your criminal record.
codes.serving_it_erases_it: Once the days are served, nothing is left on file.
codes.nothing_ever_comes_off: Nothing a school writes down ever comes off.
codes.the_handbook_is_only_advice: A student handbook is a suggestion with nothing behind it.
codes.only_the_student_can_appeal: Only the student can ask for a discipline decision to be reviewed.
codes.the_ladder_runs_backwards: The bigger discipline decisions are made lower down and the smaller ones higher up.
codes.regular_line_works_in_emergency: The police station's regular phone number works as well as 911 in an emergency.
codes.call_a_parent_first: Calling a parent before calling 911 is the right order.
codes.someone_else_will_call: Somebody nearby has already called for help, so you do not need to.
codes.emergency_calls_cost_money: Calling 911 uses minutes or costs money.
codes.needs_a_plan: A phone without a service plan cannot reach 911.
codes.emergency_calls_billed_later: You get charged afterward for calling 911.
codes.must_answer_police: You are required to answer a police officer's questions.
codes.minors_must_answer: Being under 18 removes your right to stay silent.
codes.asking_counts_as_requesting: Asking whether you need a lawyer is the same as asking for one.
codes.lawyer_arrives_automatically: A lawyer turns up on their own without you asking.
codes.lawyer_comes_after_verdict: You only get a lawyer once the case has been decided.
codes.parent_must_request_lawyer: Only a parent can ask for a lawyer on your behalf.
codes.hands_hidden_is_fine: It does not matter if your hands are out of sight during a stop.
codes.hands_do_not_matter: Where you put your hands has no effect on how a stop goes.
codes.hands_must_be_raised: You are supposed to hold your hands in the air the whole time.
codes.handle_it_yourself: A safety problem is yours to deal with rather than an adult's.
codes.friendly_means_safe: Somebody who acts nice is safe to go with.
codes.knows_my_name_means_safe: A stranger knowing your name proves they are safe.
codes.questions_make_it_safe: Asking a stranger questions first makes accepting a ride safe.
codes.innocence_makes_lying_safe: Lying is fine as long as you did nothing wrong.
codes.small_lies_are_fine: A small false answer to police does not count.
codes.police_lie_so_i_can: Police are allowed to lie, so you are too.
codes.last_word_matters: Getting the last word in an encounter is worth something.
codes.total_silence_is_the_goal: Saying nothing at all is the goal, rather than getting home safe.
codes.any_adult_is_safe: Any adult is a safe person to ask for help.
codes.helper_is_safe: Somebody who offers to help you is safer than somebody you picked.
codes.asking_makes_it_worse: Asking for help when lost makes the situation worse.
codes.name_comes_first: Your name is the first thing 911 needs.
codes.story_comes_first: 911 needs the whole story before anything else.
codes.blame_comes_first: Telling 911 who caused it is part of the call.
codes.address_is_enough: Once you give 911 an address you can hang up.
codes.help_coming_means_done: Help being on the way means the call is finished.
codes.scared_means_hang_up: Being scared is a reason to hang up on 911.
codes.parent_must_consent: You cannot refuse a search unless a parent is there.
codes.refusing_adds_punishment: Refusing to unlock your phone gets you punished more.
codes.innocence_means_you_can_go: Being innocent means you can keep walking when told to stop.
codes.asking_first_is_fine: You can ask why before deciding whether to stop.
codes.running_ends_it: Running gets you out of the situation.
codes.recording_is_illegal: Recording police is against the law.
codes.waiting_is_doing_something: Waiting longer counts as doing something about it.
codes.partial_info_is_safe: Giving out only part of where you live is safe.
codes.online_friend_is_a_friend: An account with a familiar name proves who is typing.
codes.asking_why_makes_it_safe: Asking why somebody wants your address makes answering safe.
codes.asking_is_disrespectful: Asking if you can leave is rude.
codes.asking_looks_guilty: Asking if you can leave makes you look guilty.
codes.must_wait_to_ask: You have to wait until police are finished before asking anything.
codes.parent_is_called_automatically: A parent always gets reached without you asking.
codes.wait_to_be_offered: You should wait to be offered a parent rather than asking.
codes.only_a_lawyer_can_ask: Only a lawyer can ask for your parent to be there.
codes.lawyer_only_in_court: You cannot get a lawyer until you are in a courtroom.
codes.police_decide_lawyer: Police decide whether you get a lawyer.
codes.bad_stop_means_run: An unfair stop makes running a reasonable choice.
codes.fear_justifies_running: Being scared makes running the safer option.
codes.running_works_if_unseen: Running works as long as they have not seen your face.
codes.argue_on_the_spot: Arguing during the encounter fixes an unfair stop.
codes.nothing_can_be_done: Nothing can be done about an unfair stop afterward.
codes.posting_is_fighting_it: Posting about it online counts as doing something about it.
codes.appointed_can_be_fired_freely: Appointed and hired work the same way.
codes.appointed_lawyer_serves_the_court: Whoever appointed them is who they serve.
codes.appointed_means_stuck: There is no way to raise a problem.
codes.assigned_means_confidential: Anybody assigned to you is safe.
codes.bailiff_explains_the_law: Court staff can answer legal questions.
codes.bailiff_guards_the_defendant: A bailiff is there for one person.
codes.bailiff_is_your_protector: The person nearest you is yours.
codes.bondsman_works_for_court: A bondsman works for the court.
codes.booking_files_the_charge: Paperwork at booking makes it official.
codes.closed_case_opens_the_file: Closing a case opens the file.
codes.counsel_comes_after_conviction: A lawyer helps with the sentence.
codes.court_assigns_a_bondsman: The court sets you up with one.
codes.department_sets_the_terms: The office that supervises you sets the terms.
codes.family_can_be_billed: The court can pass the bill along.
codes.free_counsel_in_every_case: Appointed counsel covers every kind of case.
codes.governor_appoints_prosecutors: The state picks each county's prosecutor.
codes.interpreter_explains: An interpreter teaches as they go.
codes.interpreter_helps_one_side: An interpreter is on that person's side.
codes.it_stays_in_the_file: It stays in the officer's own notes.
codes.judge_can_advise_you: The judge will tell you what to do.
codes.judge_cannot_hear_you_at_all: The judge cannot hear you at all until then.
codes.judge_drops_on_request: The court drops cases on request.
codes.judge_orders_fair_statements: The court orders fairness on request.
codes.judge_serves_the_defendant: The judge is on your side.
codes.judge_serves_the_state: The judge is on the state's side.
codes.judges_pick_prosecutors: The court chooses who brings cases.
codes.jury_interprets_the_law: A jury decides what the law means.
codes.jury_reviews_the_charge: A jury reviews the decision to charge.
codes.jury_sets_the_sentence: Whoever found you guilty also picks the punishment.
codes.juvenile_hearings_always_closed: Anything involving a kid is private.
codes.kind_words_mean_dismissal: A kind word signals the outcome.
codes.lawyer_can_change_terms: Your lawyer can adjust the order.
codes.lawyer_can_excuse_you: A lawyer can waive your attendance.
codes.lawyer_holds_court_file: Your lawyer holds the court's copy.
codes.lawyer_must_quit: A lawyer cannot defend somebody guilty.
codes.lawyer_must_tell_the_judge: The lawyer serves the court first.
codes.lawyer_overrides_the_client: The lawyer overrides a bad choice.
codes.lawyers_instruct_the_jury: The lawyers' arguments are the law.
codes.minors_lawyer_tells_parents: A minor's lawyer reports to parents.
codes.missing_costs_a_fine: It costs money and nothing else.
codes.must_talk_to_sender_first: You owe the sender a conversation.
codes.must_try_hiring_first: Appointed counsel is a last resort.
codes.need_a_reason_to_watch: You must be connected to the case.
codes.need_permission_to_watch: You have to be let in.
codes.no_advocate_without_paying: There is no advocate unless you hire one.
codes.no_jury_means_closed: No jury means the public is shut out.
codes.no_jury_no_trial: Without a jury it is not a real trial.
codes.officer_can_change_terms: The officer can change the terms.
codes.officer_can_drop_it: Whoever started it can stop it.
codes.one_to_one_is_off_record: One to one means off the record.
codes.parent_can_close_it: The family can clear the room.
codes.payer_handles_attendance: The person who paid is on the hook for it.
codes.private_word_with_the_judge: A private word with the judge is available.
codes.probation_officer_is_support: A probation officer is a case worker for you.
codes.prosecutor_can_advise_you: The other side can advise you fairly.
codes.prosecutor_holds_the_file: The side that filed it keeps it.
codes.prosecutor_is_neutral: A prosecutor is neutral like a judge.
codes.prosecutor_is_the_victims_lawyer: A prosecutor is the victim's lawyer.
codes.prosecutor_sets_the_bond: The side charging you names the number.
codes.prosecutor_sets_the_sentence: The side that charged you picks the punishment.
codes.public_means_recordable: If it is public you can film it.
codes.real_trials_are_elsewhere: It is a warm-up for the real one.
codes.record_catches_liars: The record is a lie detector.
codes.reporter_updates_lawyers: They report out during the hearing.
codes.sentence_is_negotiated_by_lawyers: Sentencing is worked out between the sides.
codes.victim_is_a_party: Both sides of the story are parties.
codes.warrant_needs_a_new_charge: It needs a new charge to surface.
codes.witness_decides_relevance: You decide if you are needed.
codes.you_can_ask_for_privacy: You can put it off the record.
codes.you_can_declare_privacy: You can declare a call off the record.
codes.you_pay_for_your_own: You pay for your own access.
